description: The figure is a grouped bar chart illustrating classification accuracy for an “Ours” model and several ablated variants on two datasets, with the left half labeled “PHEME” and the right half labeled “PolitiFact,” separated by a vertical dashed divider. The category axis is horizontal, showing six method labels per dataset (PHEME: Ours, w/o comments, w/o text, w/o select, w/o emotion, w/o cognition; PolitiFact: Ours, w/o comments, w/o text, w/o select, w/o emotion, w/o cognition), displayed in that left-to-right order with rotated tick labels. The value axis is vertical and labeled “Accuracy (%)” on a linear scale, spanning approximately 75 to 95 with regularly spaced tick marks every 2.5 units (e.g., 75.0, 77.5, …, 95.0). In the PHEME group, the bars are single (not stacked) and colored consistently by method: Ours (dark red) at 89.84, w/o comments (orange) at 86.82, w/o text (pale yellow) at 80.10, w/o select (very light blue) at 88.80, w/o emotion (light blue) at 87.34, and w/o cognition (dark blue) at 87.17, with each value printed above its bar. In the PolitiFact group, the same color scheme is used: Ours (dark red) at 90.57, w/o comments (orange) at 85.85, w/o text (pale yellow) at 83.02, w/o select (very light blue) at 89.62, w/o emotion (light blue) at 84.91, and w/o cognition (dark blue) at 87.74, also annotated with numeric labels above the bars. The bars are arranged by method order rather than being sorted by height, and no individual bars appear additionally emphasized beyond the consistent color coding and the value annotations.
